articles.title: Woman Killed, Eight Civilians Wounded in Houthi Sniper Attacks and Shelling in Taiz
articles.description: TAIZ-SABA A woman was killed and eight civilians, including women and children, were wounded on Sunday in sniper attacks and shelling by the Iran-backed Houthi militia in several areas of Taiz. Local sources told the Yemeni News Agency (Saba) that Ghouson Mohammed Qasim was shot dead by a Houthi sniper in Kahlan village, south of Taiz. Her husband, Ahmed Ali Qasim al-Kahlani, was also wounded while attempting to retrieve her body from the village. Seven other civilians, including four children and two women, sustained gunshot wounds, shrapnel injuries and fractures in Houthi shelling and sniper attacks targeting residential neighborhoods and villages in Kahlan, al-Najada, al-Dhabab, 30th Street, Madinat al-Noor and areas near al-Saeed Mosque. The wounded were identified as Shaker Abdullah al-Jaradi, 36; Hajar Fahd Sultan Qaid, 12; Jana Ayoub Abdulraqeeb, 9; Yasmin Abdulraqeeb Mohammed Mahyoub, 35; Fadl Ibrahim al-Ezzi Farea, 12; Dhaker Mohammed Mahyoub, 5; and Moeen Abdullah Abdu Othman, 31.
